title: LR Clonase Protocol
author: Invitrogen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfm9jk96
materials: One Shot™ OmniMAX™ 2 T1 Phage-Resistant Cells

steps.title: Prepare Reaction Mixture
steps.instruction: Combine the following components in a 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tube at room temperature and mix:

substeps.instruction: Add TE buffer (pH 8.0) to reach a total volume of 8 μL

steps.title: Prepare LR Clonase II Enzyme Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the enzyme mix for use:

substeps.instruction: Thaw LR Clonase™ II enzyme mix on ice for approximately 2 minutes
Vortex the enzyme mix briefly twice (2 seconds each time)

steps.title: Initiate LR Reaction
steps.instruction: Add the enzyme to the prepared samples and mix:

substeps.instruction: Add 2 μL of LR Clonase™ II enzyme mix to each sample from step 1
Mix well by vortexing briefly twice

steps.title: Store Enzyme Mix
steps.instruction: Return the LR Clonase™ II enzyme mix to –20°C or –80°C storage.

steps.title: Incubate Reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the reactions at 25°C for 1 hour (or overnight).

steps.title: Terminate Reaction
steps.instruction: Stop the reaction using Proteinase K:

substeps.instruction: Add 1 μL of Proteinase K solution to each sample

steps.title: Transform Cells
steps.instruction: Transform the reaction product into competent cells:

substeps.instruction: Add 1 μL of each LR reaction into 50 μL of One Shot™ OmniMAX™ 2 T1 Phage-Resistant Cells (Cat. no. C8540-03) (5 alpha e. coli)
Follow electroboration protocol for T1 Phage-Resistant Cells

steps.title: Plate and Select
steps.instruction: Plate the transformed cells on selective media:

substeps.instruction: Plate 20 μL and 100 μL of the transformation on LB plates containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin
